description: This file defines functions and types for building and summarizing channel account configurations, including inspecting accounts, formatting account details, and generating a textual summary of channel statuses.

methods.name: formatAccountLabel
methods.description: Formats an account label with optional name trimming.

methods.name: accountLine
methods.description: Creates a formatted string for an account line with label and details.

methods.name: buildAccountDetails
methods.description: Builds an array of detail strings for a channel account, including status, tokens, URLs, and permissions.

methods.name: inspectChannelAccount
methods.description: Inspects a channel account using plugin-specific or read-only methods.

methods.name: buildChannelSummary
methods.description: Generates a textual summary of all channel accounts and their statuses based on configuration and inspection.
